title: Adversarial Learning of Group and Individual Fair Representations (GIFair)
summary: Research code for the PAKDD 2024 paper proposing GIFair, a method for learning fair representations, alongside baseline implementations for comparison. One vendored baseline, DualFair, imports RDT's OneHotEncodingTransformer for its data preprocessing pipeline, so SDV's rdt component is used only inside a copied third-party baseline.
needs: rdt usage appears only inside a vendored DualFair baseline; unclear if this repo's authors chose it or it came with the copied baseline code
